cited.quote: Heritage tourism will be given a boost by restoring and renovating old forts and palaces while retaining their originality.

rationale: C1 (Governor's Address) only states an intention to restore and renovate old forts and palaces. No GO, sanction or scheme for restoring Nayaka/Palaiyakkarar/Maratha forts and palaces appears in C2-C5. Not started.
No extract mentions a Madurai-Theni-Bodi rail line. C2 covers other railway new line projects; C1, C3-C5 concern industrial corridors, MRTS studies, metro rail and flood works.

cited.quote: Sale of LED lights and Energy Efficient fans under UJALA scheme are under process.

rationale: C5 mentions LED light sales under UJALA in process, not subsidised LED bulbs for ration card holders. C1-C4 concern grocery kits, cash relief and RTI officer lists. No official step for the commitment.
No extract concerns banking sector privatisation. C1-C4 are minimum wage notifications; C5 mentions loan moratorium and MSME relief, not urging the Union to drop bank privatisation.
No extract is about veterinary camps in village panchayats. C1-C2 are patta grievance camps, C3 an SADP agency list, C4 wildlife rescue centres, C5 a village entrepreneurship programme.

cited.quote: This Government will modernize the 34 existing bus stands and provide modern integrated bus stands in major cities

rationale: C3 is a budget statement of intent to modernize bus stands; it does not mention women's facilities (toilets, shower stalls, nursing stations), and no GO or sanction for such upgrades appears in C1, C2, C4 or C5.

cited.quote: The Government issued orders to allow women, differently abled persons with disabilities of 40% and above with escort

rationale: C1 and C3 report free town-bus travel for women, differently abled and transgender persons, and C2 student concessions; none covers free travel for senior citizens above 70. Related activity only.

cited.quote: a Forest and Wildlife Crime Control Bureau shall be set up to detect and prevent organized forest and wildlife crimes

rationale: C1-C2 set up a Forest and Wildlife Crime Control Bureau, C3 rescue centres, C4-C5 a forest archive. None is a Forest Commission covering forest land, resources, conflict and residents' claims. Related steps only.

cited.quote: multi-tier cropping system will be implemented by cultivating various crops including fodder grass
The scheme aims to increase the productivity in Coconut through integrated nutrient management practices.

rationale: C4 (budget speech) announces multi-tier cropping in coconut gardens as intent only. The GO in C1/C3 sanctions an integrated nutrient management package, not layer farming. No order introducing layer farming.

cited.quote: multi-tier cropping system will be implemented by cultivating various crops including fodder grass

rationale: C4 announces multi-tier cropping in coconut gardens as intent only. No extract shows a training programme on layer farming for coconut farmers; C1/C3 is a nutrient management GO, C5 a student entrepreneurship programme.
No extract concerns wick production for fireworks or safety of women wick workers. C1 covers salt and sugar, C2/C4 lockdown rules, C3 fire services, C5 quarry workers.

cited.quote: Fish farmers will be assisted with subsidy for Pisciculture in farm ponds at an outlay of Rs. 1.3 crore.

rationale: C1 (budget) announces subsidy for pisciculture; C2-C5 are RKVY guidelines with 40-50% crop subsidies. None provides a 25% subsidy for the listed livelihoods (flower gardening, mat/basket weaving, pottery, broiler farming). Related activity only.
No extract concerns senior citizen centres. C1/C3 are IT e-services, C2/C5 urban employment scheme guidelines, C4 a home health care scheme.
No extract mentions a Karaikudi-Ramanathapuram-Thoothukudi rail line. C1 covers other rail projects; C2-C5 concern industrial corridors, buses, metro and MRTS studies.

No extract concerns the transfer process for government school teachers. C1 is about transparent recruitment by the Teachers Recruitment Board, C2-C4 about SCERT, budget and training, C5 data sharing.

cited.quote: Incentives/inputs will be provided to the farmers with Organic fields either in conversion period or organically certified
The Farmers who adopt organic farming will be encouraged with provision of inputs subsidy.

rationale: C4 is a GO (2021-10-13) sanctioning incentives/inputs to organic farmers via DBT at Rs.5000/ha, but limited to vegetable crops under horticulture projects. C1 announces a wider Organic Farming Development Scheme as intent only. Part covered.

cited.quote: CEA has approved the scheme for an amount of Rs. 1,355.14 crore. Cabinet Committee of Economic Affairs / DEA approval is to be obtained.

rationale: C1 reports Green Energy Corridor Phase II schemes (substations in Tirunelveli, Kanyakumari, Tiruppur and a 400 kV line) sent for approval, CEA approved, CCEA approval pending; not operational. Covers only some listed districts; date of the step not given.
No extract concerns a commission to regulate milk procurement and distribution prices between Aavin and producers. C2 mentions an Aavin retail price cut, C1 dairy infrastructure, C3-C5 unrelated GOs.
No extract concerns an expert committee on a professional council for civil engineers. C1-C2 are medical admissions, C3 urban employment, C4 a higher education audit, C5 surveyor training.

cited.quote: differently abled persons with disabilities of 40% and above with escort and transgender persons to travel free on town buses
all differently abled 73 persons will be permitted to travel free along with an attendant in State Government operated buses

rationale: C1 (2021-22 policy note) reports orders allowing differently abled persons with escort free travel, but only on town buses. C5 announces extension to all State Government buses, an announcement only. Reduced scope; GO date not given, year only.
